Micah Tran: Hey everyone — Micah Tran here, joining Platform (SRE) today! I'm PST, came from infra at a fintech startup. Quick Qs to unblock me today: 1) who should I ping for access to staging VMs / jumpbox? 2) do we have preferred dotfiles/devcontainer I should clone? 3) who’s my onboarding buddy? Happy to grab a sync later. Thanks!

Rashmi (People Ops): Welcome Micah! :tada: Laptop & 1Password invites should be in your email. Your onboarding buddy is Jules — looping them in. We'll also add you to the #platform and #infra-sre channels. Don't forget the security onboarding checklist (link in the onboarding doc).

Jules (Platform): hey Micah — hi! I'm Jules and I'll be your buddy. 30m sync at 3pm PT works? I'll walk you through getting ssh access and the internal devcontainer. For dotfiles we use the org repo (internal): https://git.redwood/dotfiles — clone and run `./setup.sh`. For immediate ssh try: `ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 && ssh micah@bastion.redwood`

devops-bot: account-provisioner: created GitHub invite for micah, added to team-infra, scheduled VPN invite email.

Kai (Infra): Micah — welcome! If you need immediate VM creds DM me. Note: 2FA required for jumpbox. If you're behind corp proxy use the jump-forwarding flag: `ssh -J jump.redwood:22 micah@staging`

Micah Tran: Thanks all — I got the GitHub invite. I tried the ssh command and hit a permissions error on the bastion (Permission denied (publickey)). Any quick troubleshooting tips? Also where are the runbooks for common infra tasks?

Jules (Platform): Permission denied usually means your public key wasn't uploaded to the account-provisioner. I just retriggered the key sync; try `ssh -v micah@bastion.redwood` and paste the output if it still fails. Runbooks live in Confluence under Platform > Runbooks (link posted in #platform). For first-week priorities: shadow on pager rotations, pair on a small infra ticket, and we'll do a retro at the end of week 1.

devops-bot: account-provisioner: re-synced SSH keys for micah — try again in 30s.

Micah Tran: Awesome, re-tried and success — I'm in. Quick follow-up: any recommended tiny issue I can pick up to start contributing? Also curious about the weekly onboarding lunch — is that open to remote folks?

Jules (Platform): Nice! I'll DM you a 1pt infra bug to shadow today. The onboarding lunch is Friday 12pm in SF office but we do a Zoom link for remote folks — join us! :salute:

Rashmi (People Ops): Yup remote folks always welcome — we send a calendar invite with Zoom. Also reminder to complete the security quiz by EOD Thursday.

Micah Tran: Perfect, thanks everyone. Looking forward to the 3pm sync. :rocket:
